notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
[p]Hello humblets! 🌱[/p][p][/p][p]Welcome to the very first Humblets devlog![/p][p][/p][p]We want you to continue being part of this journey, and we hope these devlogs will make you feel right here alongside us. In each update, we’ll share some of what we’ve been working on, talk a little about our design decisions, and give you a peek at how the world of Humblets is growing.[/p][p][/p][p]As with any game in development, everything you see here is still a work in progress and may change as we refine and improve. The game will keep evolving with every step we take.[/p][p][/p][p]Today, we’re excited to tell you about our procedural world generation and show off some of the new particles we’ve been adding ✨[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s jump in![/p][h2]
Procedural World 🗺️[/h2][p][/p][p]Humblets features an open procedural world, which means the game blends randomness with careful design. Every time you start a new game, a unique world is generated just for you to explore. Our system builds this world by piecing together biomes, paths, and even tiny details like road signs, making each playthrough feel fresh and original.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656621/68d8ed6f100e58d531fb272af59c3e8cf558b6c1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The world isn't just fully procedural, we'll still be going in and designing locations that will be scattered around the world. They are special locations we designed where you can meet new characters, visit shops and uncover fun spots. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656621/3a898c7743ffa6ca7ffa9cace7d582a310bf0f29.gif"][/img][/p][p]
This makes every journey feel new and exciting while guiding you to important discoveries that shape your adventure.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s really important to us to create a world players enjoy exploring and discovering on their own terms, a world that’s really theirs. Whether you meet a new character, stumble upon a hidden spot or simply wander around, we want each moment to feel special and unique to you.[/p][p][/p][p]Our procedural world also allows for plenty of replayability. Whether you’re starting a new single player game or joining with friends for a shared adventure, you’ll always have a new world to discover. And if you ever discover a world you love, you can save its “world seed” to revisit that exact same generation anytime or share it with friends.[/p][p][/p][p]In the end, our goal is to craft a game world that players want to return to, one that feels both familiar and full of surprises with every playthrough.[/p][p][/p][h2]Particle Effects 💥[/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve added some new particle effects too![/p][p][/p][p]Now, when your humblet runs or jumps, soft dust clouds rise beneath their feet.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656621/a2ff6315cd668273aa1f16d17c309ff8d9f22faf.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Dropping an item or a larger object falling stirs up a dust cloud as well, while items dropped into water create a little splash and float gently on the surface.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656621/8cab735d4cd9079f10e05125acbbbb55aef49bbe.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Chopping trees feels even more dynamic. When chopped, wood splinters fly off with each strike, dust puffs up when the tree hits the ground, and leaves fall.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656621/0553f733aa55f0b2687112ea4ca1c60ac313a5b4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And our campfires have an updated smoke effect to match our game’s cozy style.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656621/9dfb5380a73dc908845900f0bf62b59994388043.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]These small touches make interactions feel a lot more responsive, helping to bring the world to life and we have so many ideas for more.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for our very first devlog! If we want to see all our latest updates, make sure to join our Discord and follow our socials ✨ We’d also love to hear your ideas for other particle effects we could add![/p][p][/p][p]Stay cozy,
Daria and Aaron, Berry Bite 💚[/p]

notes.title: Introducing Humblets!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello humblets! 🌱[/p][p][/p][p]If you’ve been with us for a while, thank you so so much. And if you’re new here, welcome! Let us introduce ourselves and share a little about our cozy game, Humblets 🍄🌿[/p][p][/p][p]We’re a very small team, it’s just the two of us: Daria and Aaron. This game started as a little idea we’d often talk about, one we would love to play ourselves. Until one day we decided to take the leap and just started creating it! At first, we worked on it in our free time. Then, we quit our jobs to work on it more and soon after we signed with our awesome publisher [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/HypeTrainDigital"]HypeTrain Digital[/url]. Since then, for the last few months we’ve been able to work on our cozy game full time ✨ [/p][p][/p][p]Humblets is a combination of everything we love in games: open worlds, playing with friends, customising fantasy characters, collecting cards and other things. The heart of the game is simple: you’re a humblet exploring a cute world, crafting things, meeting magical beings, and collecting cards to battle with along the way.[/p][p][/p][p]In case you missed it, you can watch our announcement trailer below 👇[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="6RFEoYi-3f8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]These past months have been an absolute whirlwind! From signing with our publisher to launching our Steam page and sharing the trailer with you, it’s been an amazing start to this journey. We’ve made many new amazing friends while building our dream cozy game, and none of it would be possible without all of you in our awesome community 💚[/p][p][/p][p]If you’d like to see more cozy content and keep up with our progress, come say hello in our [url="https://discord.gg/tKx9nWsmgQ"]Discord[/url] community and check out our other socials [url="https://linktr.ee/humblets"]here[/url] 🌼[/p][p][/p][p]And if you’d like to support our journey, you can [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3694600/Humblets/"]wishlist[/url] Humblets on Steam and follow our [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/berrybite/humblets"]Kickstarter[/url]. These actions make a huge difference and mean a lot to us![/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for now, we’re excited to share more with you soon![/p][p][/p][p]Stay cozy, 
Daria and Aaron, Berry Bite 💚[/p]
